tools.name: ops_disk_usage
tools.label: Disk Usage
tools.description: Find the biggest files and directories under a path so you know what is safe to delete. Read-only. Scans /data by default.

minSize.description: Only report entries at or above this size, e.g. 500M, 2G. Defaults to 500M.

topFiles.description: Max files to list. 0 lists all matches. Defaults to 50.

topDirs.description: Max directories to list. 0 lists all matches. Defaults to 30.

followSymlinks.description: Follow symlinked directories. Off by default.

tools.name: ops_provider_quota
tools.label: Provider Quota
tools.description: Remaining quota, balance, or budget for every configured model provider, plus top-up links. Calls the DeepInfra, Groq and Perplexity APIs directly, since OpenClaw reports no usage for them. Read-only.

agent.description: Report for a specific agent id instead of the default.

groqProbe.description: Read Groq request/token limits by sending a one-token completion. Off by default because it is billable.

noProbe.description: Skip the direct provider API calls and report only what OpenClaw knows.

tools.name: ops_session_info
tools.label: Session Info
tools.description: Summary of the current OpenClaw session: session id, agent, model, token counts, host, and repo. Read-only.

tools.name: ops_update_models
tools.label: Update Models
tools.description: Merge the model list from models.md into openclaw.json. Validates before writing and keeps a timestamped backup. Changes gateway configuration.
